The '''Harlequin Biome''' is a variant of the [[Parasite Biome]] that as of now is a large Work In Progress.

==''Generation''==
The Harlequin Biome and its structures can only be spawned by using [[Commands#Harlequin_Biome_Commands|Commands]].

==''Contents''==
The Harlequin Biome's radius is denoted by gray-colored Grass covered by a dense yellow fog, similarly to the Parasite Biome. It converts Grass into Harlequin Grass Blocks, Stone and Sand into Harleskinn Blocks, and Ice into Bloody Ice. 

Attempting to enter the Harlequin Biome will inflict [[Braining]] on the player, which turns all parasites invisible, so it is recommended to avoid doing so at all costs. Healing is also halved while in this biome.

If the '/harlequin_scatter' command is used, it shows that the structures and foliage are composed of Consumed Wood, Harlequin Grass Blocks, Locs Blocks, [[Alveoli Block|Alveoli Blocks]], and [[Bronchial Tube|Bronchial Tubes]]. Many of these formations resemble rocks or trees.

Even at extremely low [[Evolution Phases]], the Biome is able to spawn powerful parasites like [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted]], [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure]], and [[:Category:Preeminent Parasites|Preeminents]] in mass numbers.

It is also considered a cold biome, due to water inside the Biome freezing over and the presence of snow when it is raining.

==''Trivia''==
*Harlequin Syndrome is a condition that causes asymmetrical sweating and redness on the skin of the upper body.
**Harlequin ichthyosis, likely what the Harlequin Grass and Harleskinn Blocks resemble, is another condition characterized by geometrical plates of hardened skin forming on fetuses or newborns.
*The Harlequin Biome is comprised of many different body parts other than skin, including hair (Locs Blocks) and the lungs (Alveoli Blocks and Bronchial Tubes).
